summary: The Phase 2 veterinarian application folded identity, verification and workflow into one five-value status. Role, Tag and Status are now three separate facts. Role stays account_role and is the only thing that opens a context or an operation; nothing added here reads or writes it. Tag is a new append-only table vet_tag_assignment holding the four professional tags (student; doctor without a practice licence; licensed doctor; trusted doctor), with general or specialist as a description inside a doctor's tag rather than a tag of its own. The database itself enforces one current tag per account with a partial unique index, a check that a student has no scope and a doctor has one, and a trigger that refuses every delete and every update except ending the current row once. Status is a pure model of the section 4 workflow with the legal transitions per actor (applicant, reviewer, server-verified event), required reasons, the tag each standing supports (an approved but unpaid licence stays unlicensed; only an active licence is licensed; waiting for payment never expires) and the compatibility mapping of the old statuses, where a Phase 2 APPROVED reads as VERIFIED_NO_LICENSE and never as licensed or trusted. The service changes a tag inside the caller's transaction under an account row lock, audits it, refuses anyone but the reviewer side or the server, refuses changes to one's own account, and treats a repeated request for the current tag as a no-op so a replayed callback cannot add a row. Migration 0031 backfills only owned, council-verified, unmerged profiles as UNLICENSED from the moment of verification with an undeclared scope, because no record ever said general or specialist; Phase 1 TRUSTED_VET role holders keep their role and get no invented trusted tag. Approving a Phase 2 application now gives the same tag in the same transaction. No advertising, unowned-page or moderation value can be stored as a tag, and there is no badge.

migrations.forwardSafe: Creates two enums, one table, its indexes, a guard trigger and a backfill INSERT; nothing existing is dropped, renamed or tightened. tests/domain/migrations.test.ts passes on it.
migrations.rerun: Drizzle records it once; tests/db/migrations.test.ts proves a second migrate is a no-op.
migrations.rollbackNote: The previous release does not read vet_tag_assignment, so it runs unchanged against this schema. To remove the feature entirely: drop trigger vet_tag_assignment_guard, function vet_tag_assignment_guard(), table vet_tag_assignment, types vet_tag and vet_practice_scope; the backfill touched no existing row. Data rollback is snapshot restore per docs/ops/runbook.md.

limitations: Public pages still show the Phase 2 axes (council verification and the Trusted Hamzist role); switching them to the single public tag is PROMPT-014. The tag exists and is readable through publicVetTag.
Workflow statuses are modelled and tested but not yet persisted on a professional case; the case table and its migration are PROMPT-003.
Tag authority is REVIEW_OPERATOR and SUPERADMIN, the existing review environment; whether the association operator joins is decided with the association admin panel in PROMPT-007.
Backfilled and Phase 2-approved doctors carry NOT_DECLARED general/specialist until they declare it in the Phase 2.5 flows (PROMPT-005/006); the public label omits that part rather than guessing.
Phase 1 TRUSTED_VET role holders received no trusted tag: licence, association membership and periodic trusted payment are not in the data (PROMPT-010/011).
